newsitem.title: USA: Donaldson Lufkin posts record income for quarter.
newsitem.headline: Donaldson Lufkin posts record income for quarter.

text.p: Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Inc. said Monday that it posted record profits and revenues in the second quarter.
The brokerage firm said its second-quarter net income rose to $100.2 million, or $1.54 a share, topping the $97.0 million, or $1.53 a share, it reported a year ago.
The New York-based company also said its total revenues for the quarter rose to a record $1.1 billion from $991.2 million last year.
DLJ cited strong fee income, primarily from mergers and acquisitions, private fund capital-raising assignments and management fees from merchant banking funds, for the improved quarterly results.
The firm said underwriting income and trading gains were lower than last year, matching industry-wide trends.
